![Image 2: GNU social](https://www.gnusocial.rocks/assets/img/gnu-social-logo.svg)**gnu**social 

The free software social networking platform.

# Features

## Versatile

GNU social supports both single-user and community modes and can be used in an intranet environment or as part of the wider Free Network.

## Accessible

Follows AnyBrowser and A11Y guidelines. It runs virtually anywhere you can run a common piece of web software, such as WordPress or Drupal. JavaScript is optional.

## Customizable

True to the Unix-philosophy of small programs to do a small job, GNU social can be easily expanded and customized via its simple plugin API.

## Privacy focused

GNU social is part of the GNU project, it's 100% free software, with no malicious features or spyware.

![Image 3: Decentralized social network.](https://www.gnusocial.rocks/assets/img/connections-gordon-johnson-pixabay.svg)

# Where can I join GNU social?

There are many kinds of GNU social server instances online right now!

[Click here](https://www.gnusocial.rocks/communities/) to see a list of popular GNU social sites you can join!

_**Disclaimer:** Please note that the GNU social development team is not responsible for the operation or content of sites that run its software._

# Support the team making GNU social possible!

## Who makes GNU social?

Many developers have been involved in the making of GNU social. It's hard to keep a precise record of so many valuable contributions.

Version 3 development is being maintained by [Diogo Cordeiro](https://www.diogo.site/), [Hugo Sales](https://hsal.es/) and [Eliseu Amaro](https://eliseuama.ro/).

Version 2 development was maintained by [Diogo Cordeiro](https://www.diogo.site/) with many important contributions from [Alexei Sorokin](https://loadaverage.org/XRevan86) and the help of [Summer of Code students](https://www.gnusocial.rocks/soc/).

The project started with [Matt Lee](https://mat.tl/) and StatusNet with [Evan Prodromou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evan_Prodromou). It was since been maintained by [Mikael Nordfeldth](http://mmn-o.se/).

A list of contributors is available [here](https://code.undefinedhackers.net/GNUsocial/gnu-social/src/branch/experimental/CREDITS.md).

## Discuss

Discuss the project on:

 XMPP: [xmpp:gnusocial@conference.bka.li?join](xmpp:gnusocial@conference.bka.li?join),

 IRC: [ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/#social](ircs://irc.libera.chat:6697/#social) or

 Matrix: [#social:libera.chat](https://matrix.to/#/#social:libera.chat).

Contribute code, report bugs and request features on our [repository](https://notabug.org/diogo/gnu-social).

You can also ask for help on our [mailing list](https://lists.gnu.org/mailman/listinfo/social-discuss).

If you are a student you can also apply to [GNU social's Summer of Code](https://www.gnusocial.rocks/soc).

# Now your posts, feed and connections belong to you, not a corporation.

Nos is built on [Nostr](https://nos.social/blog/nostr-user-led-social-media), a decentralized, user-led protocol. Traditional social media platforms treat you as the product—focusing on ad revenues, profits, and engagement metrics. Finally, a social app that puts you in control.

[iOS Download](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nos-social/id1670125746)

![Image 2: Pictures of the Home feed, Threads, Discover and Notifications screen](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/6761c593069d0edf1f726be7_Hero-3-phones.webp)

![Image 3](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669a56da69918beb0d0fda82_feed-icon.svg)
## Your feed,

your choice

See content from people who matter most to you.

Content appears in reverse chronological order based on the people you follow.

![Image 4: A screenshot of the Nos app open in the Thread view, displaying an overlay on a note from an unknown user](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/66e054d8cd789f85f86bf048_your-feed.webp)

![Image 5: A grid of several notes posted by Nos users](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669a3b02259c979f776dfcd2_ad-free.webp)

![Image 6](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669a5e963db3221528278dcd_no-ads-icon.svg)
## Ad-free social media

View notes without interruption with the confidence that your browsing habits remain your own.

On Nostr, we’re building for users, not advertisers.

[![Image 7: A grid of many Nostr app icons](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669a3b02259c979f776dfce5_many-apps.webp)](http://nostrapps.com/)

![Image 8](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669a59d11ab176d6e9098080_identity-icon.svg)
## One identity,

many apps

Nostr is home to [over 50 different apps](http://nostrapps.com/). A single Nostr account gets you access to all of them!

Logging into another app will instantly connect you to your network - both the people you follow and those who follow you.

![Image 9: Logos of Activity Protocol, Mastodon and BlueSky](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65f32b5e045a6a52deacd47c/669e60ec659c956f2b5f94d0_other-protocols.webp)

## Connect with friends from other protocols

Nostr is the hub for connecting with friends on Mastodon and Bluesky.

See everyone’s content. Engage with people on Mastodon and Bluesky.

![Image 10: An illustration of a decentralised network of users on the Nostr protocol](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e0969475229f991b46566/664e0969475229f991b4673a_cooperative-commons.png)

## Building a healthy commons together

Open Source, Open Society. Look under the hood at how Nos is built and roll up your sleeves to add to the app yourself.

![Image 11](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e0969475229f991b46566/664e0969475229f991b4672f_versioning-icon.svg)

# Open Source

Nos and Nostr are [open source](https://github.com/planetary-social/nos/). Transparency is real when you can read and modify the source code.

![Image 12](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/664e0969475229f991b46566/664e0969475229f991b46739_shaka-icon.svg)

# Get involved!

Follow us on [GitHub](https://github.com/planetary-social/nos)

## Protocols as the future of social media

Listen to experts at the intersection of social media and information access share their insights as to why protocols are critical for the future of social media and information dissemination.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aA-jiiepOrE)

Can we fix it?

"Most people agree that Social Media is broken and that we need to find new solutions. I embarked on a journey to find out more about a new invention called NOSTR.

Join me and see how I was able to understand more about that technology."

Max DeMarco

"I'm not on Instagram.

I'm not on Facebook.

I'm not on Tik Tok and I never was. 

Nostr to me seems like more than just another big media property, specifically because the idea that it's an unowned protocol. That to me is attractive, that's something I want to see succeed."

"This is my happy place."

## How is AltSocial different from other social media platforms?

### Quality over quantity.

Sensible limits for your feed, posts, friends & time spent in the app.

No infinite/doom scroll or time suck. Your home feed always ends.

### No algorithms. Chronological feed.

Your feed will always show the most recent content first i.e. chronological order.

Your feed will never be optimized by algorithms or AI.

No unexpected, unfollowed, random, popular, meme content.

### Connect with real people you know only.

Only real people can sign up. No companies, bots, businesses, brands etc.

You can only connect with people you know personally i.e. friends, family etc.

No influencers, followers, followings. All connections are mutual and on the same level.

### A social enterprise business.

We exist to address the currently broken social media landscape and not to maximize profit.

We don't seek to maximize your attention or time.

This allows us to create and foster more meaningful online social experiences.

## Help AltSocial go live!

We need your help to make AltSocial a reality. You can support us by becoming an investor from $1,000 USD.

[Invest in AltSocial](https://www.altsocial.net/invest)[Learn more](https://www.altsocial.net/about?section=support)

A new kind of social
# Social without

distraction.

Mirlo is built for the people who actually matter to you. No likes, no public comments, no algorithm or engagement hooks competing for your attention.

[![Image 2: Download on the App Store](https://mirlo.social/badges/app-store.svg)](https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/mirlo/id6760918863)[![Image 3: Get it on Google Play](https://mirlo.social/badges/google-play.png)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.mirlo.social)

![Image 4: Two friends sharing a moment on Mirlo](https://mirlo.social/_next/image?url=%2Fhero-main.webp&w=3840&q=75)

## Built in Europe,

hosted in Europe.

We chose European infrastructure from day one — not as a marketing afterthought. Your account, posts, and messages live on EU servers.

[Learn more](https://mirlo.social/eu-privacy)

### Built in the Netherlands

“Mirlo Social” is registered at KvK — a real company, not a shell.

### Hosted in the EU

Your account data, posts, and messages are stored in Ireland (AWS eu-west-1), within the EU, under Supabase's EU data processing agreement.

### GDPR by design

No ads, no data brokering. Data minimisation, full export, and the right to deletion — baked in from the start.

Why Mirlo
## Designed to feel different.

Built without the engagement hooks other apps depend on. No infinite scroll, no algorithm chasing your attention, no metrics asking to be optimised. Designed to be used and put down.

![Image 5: Mirlo feed showing posts without likes or comments](https://mirlo.social/1-mirlo-feed-light@1x.png)

![Image 6: Mirlo profile page showing mutual connection request](https://mirlo.social/2-mirlo-profile-light@1x.png)

![Image 7: Mirlo chat showing a private conversation in response to a post](https://mirlo.social/3-mirlo-chat-light@1x.png)

![Image 8: Mirlo content preferences screen with toggles for nudity, graphic content, and sensitive topics](https://mirlo.social/4-mirlo-preferences-light@1x.png)

❤️
### No likes or public comments

Post without performing. There are no counts, no reactions, no public validation loops. Just sharing, for its own sake.

![Image 9: Mirlo feed showing posts without likes or comments](https://mirlo.social/1-mirlo-feed-light@1x.png)

🤝
### Mutual connections only

Both sides have to agree before you're connected. And since every account is phone-verified, you know the people you connect with are real.

![Image 10: Mirlo profile page showing mutual connection request](https://mirlo.social/2-mirlo-profile-light@1x.png)

💬
### Respond privately, not publicly

Tap to respond to any post and the conversation moves to a private DM. Real reactions happen in private — not in a comment section.

![Image 11: Mirlo chat showing a private conversation in response to a post](https://mirlo.social/3-mirlo-chat-light@1x.png)

🎉
### Your feed, your rules

You decide what you see. Toggle graphic content and sensitive topics on or off. Nudity content is available for users aged 18 and older. Your preferences are saved to your account.

![Image 12: Mirlo content preferences screen with toggles for nudity, graphic content, and sensitive topics](https://mirlo.social/4-mirlo-preferences-light@1x.png)

How it works
## Up and running in minutes.

01

### Sign up with your phone number

No email required. A quick SMS code and you're in. Phone verification means every person on Mirlo is real — no bots, no fake accounts.

![Image 13: Mirlo sign up screen](https://mirlo.social/1-mirlo-login-light@1x.png)

02

### Connect with people you actually know

Search by username and send a request. They accept, you're connected. Both ways, always.

![Image 14: Mirlo friends and connections screen](https://mirlo.social/2-mirlo-friends-light@1x.png)

03

### Share moments, respond in private

Post photos or moments. When someone wants to respond, they'll slide into your DMs — not your comments section.

![Image 15: Mirlo chat screen showing a private response to a post](https://mirlo.social/3-mirlo-respond-light@1x.png)

Who it's for
## Made for users.

Not for shareholders.

If you've quietly closed the apps that stopped working for you, you're who Mirlo was built for. No algorithm reshuffling your feed to maximise time spent. No infinite scroll. No engagement hooks designed to keep you on the app. No advertisers targeting your demographics. No board demanding quarterly growth at the cost of the product itself.

Just a small app, a small team, and one job — making something worth paying for.

![Image 16: Four friends laughing and taking a selfie together outdoors on a sunny day](https://mirlo.social/_next/image?url=%2Fwho-its-for.webp&w=3840&q=75)

## €4.99/mo

or **€34.99/year**— save 42%

No ads. No data selling. No compromises.

Starts with a 14-day free trial.

### No ads. Ever.

Ads require attention-maximising design. We don't want that, and neither do you. Mirlo will never run ads.

### Your data is yours.

We don't sell, analyse, or profit from your personal data. Your posts, messages, and connections are private — full stop.

### Incentives that make sense.

When you pay for a product, you are the customer — not the product. Our only job is to make Mirlo worth it.

### Built to last.

Subscriptions keep the lights on without compromising the product. Mirlo is built to stick around.

### Real people only.

Every account is verified by phone number. No bots, no fake accounts, no throwaway profiles — just real people.

## Ready for social media

 that actually feels good?

Download Mirlo and start sharing with the people who matter — without the distraction.

# A Human-Centered Social Media Ecosystem

Social media was meant to connect us. Instead, today's dominant platforms are built on incentives that undermine trust, weaken communities, and extract value from users and creators.

Mosaic is an effort to design an open, interoperable social media ecosystem that puts people, communities, and the public good first.

[[Explore how it works](https://www.mosaic.social/)](https://www.mosaic.social/ecosystem-design)Get involved

## Social media is harming society

The problem with today's social media isn't just content or moderation—it's structural.

Most platforms are optimized for advertising and engagement above all else. Opaque algorithms amplify conflict and polarization. Personal data is harvested and monetized. Creators and communities are locked into systems they don't control.

The result is a digital environment that distorts public discourse, erodes trust, and weakens civil liberties in the digital age.

![Image 3: Diverse community gathering in a sunny town square](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/sunny_town_square_with_diverse_community_gathering-CioWdpnf.png)

## It doesn't have to be this way

A healthier social media ecosystem is possible.

Many of the core building blocks already exist: decentralized identity, personal data stores, open social protocols, and community-based platforms. What’s missing is coherence—an integrated way to align these pieces into a decentralized, high-performance social media ecosystem that people can use at scale.

Mosaic's role is to provide that missing connective tissue.

## What is Mosaic?

Mosaic is not a new social media app.

It is an ecosystem design and implementation effort that connects independent technologies and services into a unified, human-centered alternative to Big Tech social media.

Rather than rebuilding everything from scratch, Mosaic integrates what already works—while addressing the gaps that have held previous efforts back, including coordination, governance, performance, and economic sustainability.

![Image 4: Mosaic coherence diagram showing governance, protocols, web standards, performance, business models, and spaces connected through Mosaic](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/Ecosystem_Design_Hex_Array_1768337134617-ooLUrA4E.png)

## How Mosaic works

Mosaic brings together four core components into a coherent ecosystem:

### People

Each person has a portable, user-controlled digital identity that works across the ecosystem and is not owned by any single company.

### Personal data

Your data lives in a personal data store you control, rather than being locked inside a platform's database.

![Image 5: Spaces](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/icons/spaces-hexagons.svg)

### Spaces

Social interaction happens inside independent Spaces—communities, publications, creator hubs, civic groups, or private circles.

![Image 6: River Flow](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/icons/river-flow.svg)

### The River

Updates from the Spaces you follow flow into a unified, customizable feed—filtered using methods and algorithms you choose.

Together, these elements form an open social ecosystem that restores choice, agency, and accountability.

[[Explore the full architecture](https://www.mosaic.social/)](https://www.mosaic.social/ecosystem-design)

![Image 7: Abstract network background](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/subtle_contour_lines_abstract_background-DjtxDuWx.png)

## Who Mosaic is for

### Individuals

seeking healthier, more intentional online spaces. Control what you see and how information reaches you. Choose which algorithms—or non-algorithmic filters—shape your experience. Built for individual sovereignty and well-being, not endless scrolling.

### Communities

that need autonomy and tools tailored to their purpose. Set your own norms, moderation, and features—no one-size-fits-all rules imposed from above. Stay independent while connecting to the broader network.

### Creators

who want direct, lasting relationships with their audiences—without platform middlemen deciding what gets seen or how you make money. Choose your own tools and business model. Your content, your identity, and your audience relationships belong to you.

### Society and democracy

needs social infrastructure which is open, transparent, and accountable to the societies it shapes. Mosaic is an open and auditable ecosystem that enables new forms of collective sensemaking and a participatory model of digital democracy.

## A collaborative design process

The social media problem spans technology, governance, economics, mental health, and democracy. No single person or organization can solve it alone.

Mosaic's next step is a collaborative ecosystem design process—bringing together technologists, social scientists, creators, service providers, and funders to define the standards, governance, and architecture for a new social media commons.

[[View the Ecosystem Design (Working Draft)](https://www.mosaic.social/)](https://www.mosaic.social/ecosystem-design)

![Image 8: Collaborative design process illustration](https://www.mosaic.social/assets/image_1767116064187_transparent-DFj7Ifjw.png)

## Get involved

If this vision resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for collaborators, partners, advisors, and funders who are interested in helping shape a healthier social web.

[contact@mosaic.social](mailto:contact@mosaic.social)

# The ads.The algorithm.The tracking. Your friends.

Social media, cut back to the part that was worth keeping: a chronological feed of people you actually know. Personal accounts are free.

[Create your free account](https://joinsocia.com/register)[See how it works](https://joinsocia.com/#how-it-works)

Free forever for people. Invite only while we grow.

How it works

## Three rules, and we don't break them.

Most of what makes social media exhausting comes from a business model, not from technology. Change the business model and most of it goes away.

### The feed is in order

Posts from the people you follow, newest first. Nothing gets boosted, nothing gets buried, and nothing is reordered to keep you scrolling.

### Nobody is watching

No advertising, no trackers, no selling your behaviour to anyone. There is no third party in the room when you post.

### Private until you say so

You choose who sees every post — just you, your friends, or anyone who follows you. Even the details on your profile have their own switches, one by one.

What's inside

## Enough to stay in touch. Not much more.

We'd rather do a handful of things properly than bolt on everything.

### Friends and follows

Friends are mutual, like in real life. Follows are one-way, for the people whose posts you want anyway. We never blur the two.

### Messages

Proper private conversations — quick replies, photos, the lot — without a company reading over your shoulder.

### Communities

A quiet corner for the group that outgrew the group chat — the book club, the five-a-side team, your friends from uni.

### A profile that's actually you

Arrange little cards for whatever you're into right now — reading, listening to, building — instead of a one-line bio you wrote years ago.

### Pages

Run a band, a shop or a newsletter? A Page keeps that life separate from your personal one, and your audience separate from your friends.

### Get paid by your fans

If people love what you make, they can subscribe to you directly. You set the price, and we only earn when you do.

Pricing

## Free for people. Paid for organisations.

A network only works if your friends can be on it too, so we don't charge people to be here. Organisations pay instead.

Free

Personal accounts

*   Posting, friends and follows
*   Private messages
*   Private communities and your full profile
*   No card, ever

$15 / month

Per Page

*   For businesses, bands and publications
*   Followers and audience insights
*   Run it together with your team
*   Sell subscriptions to your audience

Opening a community to the public is a paid upgrade too — private ones stay free.

Questions

## The honest answers.

### Is a personal account really free?

Yes. Everything a personal account does — posting, friends, messages, private communities — costs nothing, and we never ask for a card. The bills get paid by businesses running Pages and by our small share of what creators earn — [the full breakdown is here](https://joinsocia.com/how-we-make-money).

### Do I need an invite?

For now, yes. Growing slowly is how we keep the place civil and the moderation load honest. If you don't have a code from a friend, you can join the waitlist when you [start signing up](https://joinsocia.com/register).

### Will you sell my data or show me ads?

No. Not now and not later — it's the specific thing this whole project exists to avoid. You can see exactly what we store on the [data page](https://joinsocia.com/data-views).

### Can I make money here?

Yes — if people want to support what you make, they can subscribe to you for posts and communities only they get to see. You set the price, Stripe sends you the money, and we take a small cut of what you actually earn. Nothing up front.

### What happens if I want to leave?

You delete your account and your content goes with it. There's no dark pattern in the way, and nothing of yours has been sold on to anyone else in the meantime.
